alt: Wolfberg Arch, a natural sandstone arch in the Cederberg
caption: Wolfberg Arch, a sandstone window in the Cederberg Wilderness Area. Day 5 is the eight-hour hike to it, the physical high point of the Cederberg camp.

alt: San rock art of five figures wearing karosses in a sandstone shelter near Stadsaal Caves
caption: San paintings of five figures in karosses (skin cloaks) in a sandstone shelter near Stadsaal Caves. This is the Cederberg's rock-art visit on day 4, before camping.

commonsFile: File:Cape Town (ZA), Cape Point Nature Reserve, Ausblick -- 2024 -- 3377.jpg
location: Cape Point, Table Mountain National Park
alt: View from the Cape Point headland over cliffs and the ocean
caption: The cliffs of Cape Point, where the Cape peninsula ends. Day 13 walks the Cape of Good Hope trail here before the 4x4 goes back and the flight home.

alt: The Maximum Security Prison building on Robben Island
caption: The Maximum Security Prison on Robben Island, where political prisoners were held under apartheid. The ferry visit on day 3 is the trip's main historical stop.

alt: Colourful terraced houses lining a Bo-Kaap street with Table Mountain behind
caption: Brightly painted houses of Bo-Kaap, the Cape Malay quarter beneath Signal Hill. Day 2 pairs a walk here with the District Six Museum.

alt: The Swartberg Pass road running over the Swartberg mountain range
caption: The R328 climbing over the Swartberg range. Day 8 drives this gravel pass, the route into Gamkaskloof.

alt: The old Gamkaskloof farm settlement in the Swartberg valley known as Die Hel
caption: The Gamkaskloof settlement at Die Hel, a remote valley with no road until 1962. Day 9's overnight stay means sleeping in the valley itself.

commonsFile: File:HOOP - Coastal dunes and fynbos at Koppie Alleen, De Hoop Nature Reserve, South Africa, 2017.jpg
location: Koppie Alleen, De Hoop Nature Reserve
alt: Coastal dune landscape with fynbos vegetation at Koppie Alleen
caption: Fynbos-covered coastal dunes at Koppie Alleen in De Hoop Nature Reserve. Day 11 ends the inland section with a dune walk and a coastal camp.

alt: Open semi-desert plain in Tankwa Karoo National Park
caption: Open gravel plain in Tankwa Karoo National Park, a 1,436 km² semi-desert. Day 6 camps here after the Katbakkies gravel road, with an evening wildlife drive and stars.

alt: Table Mountain's flat summit seen from Cape Town, Western Cape
caption: Table Mountain, the flat-topped landmark above Cape Town. Day 3 goes up by cable car or with a certified guide, after the Robben Island ferry.

commonsFile: File:AGU - Cape Agulhas Lighthouse, South Africa, 2017.jpg
alt: Cape Agulhas Lighthouse, first lit in 1849, at the southern tip of South Africa
caption: Cape Agulhas Lighthouse, lit in 1849, at the southern tip of Africa. Day 12 starts here before the coast road west to False Bay.

alt: African penguins on the sand at Boulders Beach, Simon's Town
caption: African penguins at Boulders Beach in Simon's Town. Day 12 ends here in the late afternoon, the evening before Cape Point.

alt: The District Six Museum building on Albertus Street, Cape Town
caption: The District Six Museum, built around the memory of the Cape Town district cleared under apartheid. It is the day-2 history stop alongside Bo-Kaap.
